edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the dispute between them that is the subject of this Agreement (the “Dispute”). The parties shall identify the Dispute by case caption and number, if applicable, or an agreed description before execution.
edits.name: Scope of dispute

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [OPENING SETTLEMENT AMOUNT SUBJECT TO CLIENT APPROVAL] within ten business days after the date on which both parties have executed this Agreement (the “Effective Date”), by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Plaintiff shall provide its wire instructions at least three business days before the payment deadline. The settlement amount must be agreed and inserted before execution.
edits.name: Payment proposal

edits.text: 2. MUTUAL RELEASES. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full settlement amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff and Defendant each release the other from all claims arising from the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the Effective Date. These releases do not extend to unrelated claims or to rights and obligations under this Agreement, including the right to enforce it.
edits.name: Mutual dispute-limited releases

edits.text: 3. MUTUAL CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers, as required by law or legal process, or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Each party shall inform advisers receiving disclosure of the confidential nature of the terms and instruct them to maintain confidentiality. Where legally permitted and reasonably practicable, a party making a legally required disclosure shall give the other party advance notice and disclose only what is required.
edits.name: Mutual confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement is a compromise of disputed claims and does not constitute an admission of liability or wrongdoing by either party.
edits.name: Mutual no-admission provision
